pairs: Nuntiavit autem Achab Jezabel omnia quæ fecerat Elias,
Then Ahab reported to Jezebel all that Elijah had done,
et quomodo occidisset universos prophetas gladio.
and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
And so Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah,
and may they add these other things,
nisi hac hora cras posuero animam tuam sicut animam unius ex illis.
if by this hour tomorrow I will not have made your life like the life of one of them.”
et surgens abiit quocumque eum ferebat voluntas:
And rising up, he went away to wherever his will would carry him.
And he arrived in Beersheba of Judah.
And he dismissed his servant there.
And he continued on, into the desert,
and was sitting under a juniper tree,
petivit animæ suæ ut moreretur, et ait:
he requested for his soul that he might die.
“It is enough for me, O Lord.
neque enim melior sum quam patres mei.
Take my soul. For I am no better than my fathers.”
and he slept deeply in the shadow of the juniper tree.
et ecce angelus Domini tetigit eum,
an Angel of the Lord touched him,
et ecce ad caput suum subcinericius panis,
at his head was bread baked under ashes,
And the Angel of the Lord returned a second time,
For a great journey again stands before you.”
And he when he had risen up,
And he walked by the strength of that food for forty days and forty nights,
et ambulavit in fortitudine cibi illius quadraginta diebus
as far as the mountain of God,
et quadraginta noctibus usque ad montem Dei Horeb.
And when he had arrived there,
he stayed in a cave. And behold,
et ecce sermo Domini ad eum,
the word of the Lord came to him,
and said to him, “What are you doing here,
Zelo zelatus sum pro Domino Deo exercituum,
“I have been very zealous on behalf of the Lord, the God of hosts.
quia dereliquerunt pactum tuum filii Israël:
For the sons of Israel have forsaken your covenant.
They have torn down your altars.
prophetas tuos occiderunt gladio, derelictus sum ego solus,
They have killed your prophets with the sword. I alone remain.
et quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam.
And they are seeking my life, so that they may take it away.”
“Go out and stand on the mount before the Lord.”
et sta in monte coram Domino:
And there was a great and strong wind,
and crushing the rocks before the Lord.
But the Lord was not in the wind.
But the Lord was not in the earthquake.
And after the earthquake, there was a fire.
But the Lord was not in the fire.
Et post ignem sibilus auræ tenuis.
And after the fire, there was the whisper of a gentle breeze.
And when Elijah had heard it,
he covered his face with his cloak,
et egressus stetit in ostio speluncæ.
and going out, he stood at the entrance of the cave.
Et ecce vox ad eum dicens:
And behold, there was a voice to him,
Zelo zelatus sum pro Domino Deo exercituum,
“I have been very zealous on behalf of the Lord, the God of hosts.
quia dereliquerunt pactum tuum filii Israël:
For the sons of Israel have forsaken your covenant.
They have torn down your altars.
prophetas tuos occiderunt gladio, derelictus sum ego solus,
They have killed your prophets with the sword. I alone remain.
et quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam.
And they are seeking my life, so that they may take it away.”
And the Lord said to him:
et revertere in viam tuam per desertum in Damascum:
and return on your way, through the desert, to Damascus.
And when you have arrived there,
you shall anoint Hazael as king over Syria.
et Jehu filium Namsi unges regem super Israël:
And you shall anoint Jehu, the son of Nimshi, as king over Israel.
But Elisha, the son of Shaphat,
qui est de Abelmehula, unges prophetam pro te.
who is from Abelmeholah, you shall anoint to be a prophet in your place.
whoever will have escaped from the sword of Hazael,
And whoever will have escaped from the sword of Jehu,
will be put to death by Elisha.
Et derelinquam mihi in Israël septem millia virorum,
And I will leave for myself seven thousand men in Israel,
quorum genua non sunt incurvata ante Baal,
whose knees have not been bent before Baal,
et omne os quod non adoravit eum osculans manus.
and every mouth that has not adored him, kissing hands.”
Therefore, Elijah, setting out from there,
found Elisha, the son of Shaphat,
plowing with twelve yoke of oxen.
Et ipse in duodecim jugis boum arantibus unus erat:
And he himself was one of those who were plowing with the twelve yoke of oxen.
And when Elijah had gone to him,
he cast his mantle over him.
Qui statim relictis bobus cucurrit post Eliam,
“I beg you to let me kiss my father
and then I will follow you.”
For what was mine to do,
he took a pair of oxen,
et mactavit illud, et in aratro boum coxit carnes,
and he slew them. And he cooked the flesh with the plow of the oxen.
And he gave it to the people,
